name: korean-mail-mcp
description: Connects a Naver, Daum or Kakao mailbox to Claude through an MCP server: search, read, draft, send, move and trash mail over IMAP and SMTP. One server serves one account, chosen by the domain of the address

mail_address.title: Mail address
mail_address.description: Full address of the account, such as your_id@naver.com. Its domain (naver.com, daum.net, hanmail.net or kakao.com) picks the mail service

mail_password.title: IMAP password
mail_password.description: The password for IMAP and SMTP, not the account password: a Naver application password, or the one Daum or Kakao shows on its IMAP settings page

mail_full_name.title: Display name
mail_full_name.description: Name shown as the sender of mail you send. Leave empty to send with the address alone
